crossRefs.note: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the…
the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother…
They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.
They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he…
Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah…
He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.

translations.web: He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
translations.bsb: Peter took her by the hand and helped her up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.
translations.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
translations.asv: And he gave her his hand, and raised her up; and calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
